result.stdout:
Description:
  Interactive Picket report triage and scan workspace.

Usage:
  picket-tui [<report>] [options]

Arguments:
  <report>  Report file to summarize or open.

Options:
  --flow           Run the report triage console as inline terminal steps.
  --scan           Open the native scan workspace instead of loading an existing report.
  -t, --tab <1-6>  Start on a tab by number: 1 Dashboard, 2 Scan, 3 Findings, 4 Rules, 5 Files, or 6 Logs. [default: 1]
  -?, -h, --help   Show help and usage information
  --version        Show version information
